title: Item:Skeleton Key Crest
wikitext:
[[File:Skeleton Key Crest orb.png||right|alt=Skeleton Key Crest, focus orb]]
[[File:Skeleton Key Crest.png|thumb|420px|Skeleton Key Crest]]

This special crest can fit into any crest slot of any type. Usable in assassination challenges. Can only be used once per party per challenge.

Acquired by:
* {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}.
** {{Unverified|Breakables}} in Dr. Rushmore's Mansion
* Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.

Usable in the following assassination challenges:
* [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Behind the Door]]
* [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Moving Targets]]
* [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Moving Targets - EPIC]]
* [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Picture Portals]]
* [[Dr. Rushmore's Mansion: Picture Portals - EPIC]]
